name: Data.range_tupleIdem_le
summary: e₀ is the sum of the orthogonal idempotents of the good tuples and is central, so f(idem c) = f(e₀)·f(idem c).

steps.claim: tupleIdem c = e₀·tupleIdem c (the idempotents are orthogonal and e₀ is their sum over the good tuples, of which c is one: mul_sum_of_mem), e₀ commutes with it (central projection), and f is multiplicative.
The range of a composite is contained in the range of the outer map.
